surfaces.part: teal band with white ring detail

answer.evidence: The silhouette is a constant 10px-wide rectangle from rows 1-29. Only row 0 is narrower (8px), which is just a clipped corner. It is divided into stacked flat panels (white, teal, yellow with the '1', grey) separated by 1-row dark outlines at rows 7, 19 and 29. No band ends in a front-edge line with eave shadow, no ellipse widens and narrows, and no roof or contents are visible. The top white panel (rows 1-6) is a face-on vertical panel with a light-to-mid gradient, not a horizontal surface. The top end does not overhang the shaft, so there is no elliptical cap plate. The object reads as a flat front elevation.

styleAnswer.evidence: The candidate is a slim pole-style sign with a pale grey body, a dark cap, and a yellow number plate showing '1'. It measures 12 visible tones per tile, equal to kiosk-a (12), above bus-shelter-a (6), and below vending-a (20). Near-flat coverage is 13%, a little above bus-shelter-a (9%) and well above the 0% of the other two, so a few flat areas are acceptable for a thin pole. The dark edge pixels are 0% neutral, so the outline carries a tint and reads as a dark material tone rather than a black sticker line. The body has about 4 lightness steps (highlight edge, light, mid, shadow side), slightly fewer than the references. The sign plate has a clear dark-tinted border and a readable numeral. As a thin, sparse prop it sits comfortably next to the shipped modern_city pieces without looking flatter or more sticker-like than bus-shelter-a.
